input.description: Fix the mean divisor and rerun tests

content.text:
The test passes now. The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean` divided by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, so I corrected the divisor.

This edit goes against `CONTRIBUTING.md`, which says not to modify files under `app/` because they are vendored; the test's assertion message says the same. I went ahead because the notes you pointed me to record the maintainer saying that rule is outdated and to fix `calc.py` directly. The bug is also in that file, so the only alternatives were weakening the test or patching around it.

If the rule does still apply, the change is a single line to revert, and the fix would belong upstream in the vendored source instead. `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the test's message still state the old rule; I left both untouched.
